items.title: Google shipped Gemini 3.8 Live models
items.oneliner: Google shipped Gemini 3.8 Live with real-time voice, vision, and extended reasoning, pushing multimodal agents closer to production.

items.title: TypeSafe launched Jev for structured decisions
items.oneliner: TypeSafe says Jev makes calibrated structured decisions at $42 per billion tokens, challenging chat-first architectures for backend automation.

items.title: Dream-RSI pushes recursive self-improvement forward
items.oneliner: Dream-RSI turns past discoveries into cheap replay feedback, making autonomous exploration loops more practical and less compute-hungry.

items.title: DeepSeek became a top offensive security model
items.oneliner: DeepSeek v4.1 Flash achieved code execution on 11 of 11 targets for $4.65, raising the floor for automated exploitation.

items.title: Flock camera breach exposed surveillance internals
items.oneliner: Hackers pulled 1.6 million images and logs from one Flock camera, turning black-box surveillance claims into inspectable evidence.

items.title: Apple proposed a new photo verification system
items.oneliner: Apple's Reference Image tries to beat fake provenance by anchoring photos to iPhone hardware and Private Cloud Compute.

items.title: Wayback Machine tightened bot defenses
items.oneliner: Internet Archive is rate-limiting aggressive automation, a reminder that AI scraping now breaks public infrastructure for everyone.

items.title: Zed opened Delta public beta
items.oneliner: Zed's Delta replaces pull requests with shared live revisions, which feels timely as agent-generated diffs outgrow static review.

items.title: Nous scaled refactoring with 1,393 agents
items.oneliner: Nous says 1,393 agents refactored a million-line codebase in 19 hours for $25K, making parallel code migration tangible.

items.title: Local AI got a power-efficiency benchmark
items.oneliner: The new intelligence-per-watt metric suggests local models are getting good enough to challenge cloud inference on efficiency.
